umbrella.name: Deutsches Studierendenwerk (DSW)
umbrella.what: National association of all 57 Studierendenwerke. Represents them politically and publishes the yearly statistics this site uses for student numbers.

umbrella.name: Arbeitsgemeinschaft Studierendenwerke NRW
umbrella.what: Working group of the twelve Studierendenwerke in North Rhine-Westphalia. Publishes a joint yearly performance report.

umbrella.name: Arbeitsgemeinschaft Niedersächsischer Studentenwerke
umbrella.what: Represents the shared interests of Lower Saxony's Studierendenwerke towards the state government. Each one is represented by its managing director.

umbrella.name: ARGE Studierendenwerke Süd-West, Arbeitsgruppe Baden-Württemberg
umbrella.what: Working group of the managing directors of Baden-Württemberg's Studierendenwerke. Speaks jointly to state politics, for example with election questionnaires.

highlights.title: Mensa TU Veggie 2.0
highlights.text: A fully plant-based canteen at TU Berlin, open since April 2019. It was Berlin's first.

highlights.title: Rote Bete
highlights.text: AKAFÖ's fully plant-based restaurant on the Ruhr-Universität campus, opened on 11 January 2022.

highlights.title: v²onnem plant-based butchery
highlights.text: The Studierendenwerk makes its own plant-based alternatives to meat in-house and serves them across its canteens. Registered as a brand in 2025.

highlights.title: Mensa Kunstakademie
highlights.text: A canteen without meat, with a mostly plant-based menu. Rated 4.5 of 5 in PETA's 2025 canteen ranking.

highlights.title: Mensa Neuwerk, fully plant-based January
highlights.text: Ran a fully plant-based menu for the whole of January 2026.

highlights.title: Mensateria Hubland Nord
highlights.text: The student parliament resolved in November 2025 that this canteen should reopen without meat, and that a fully plant-based canteen be examined afterwards.

highlights.title: Plant-based Thursdays trial
highlights.text: Tested a plant-based-only menu on four Thursdays in January 2026 and surveyed guests about it.
